description:
About the company
 Our client is a defense technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Create and own internal software tooling that lets engineers verify autonomy code without relying solely on field trials. The work spans scenario authoring, reuse of recorded data and automated scoring of results, with colleagues depending on the tooling every day.
 What you'll do
 - Develop dependable C++ tooling for virtual testing and for re-running recorded vehicle sessions against the latest software.
 - Stitch together logged sensor data, virtual environments and production code so tests run automatically and can be repeated.
 - Create test frameworks that check autonomous behavior with and without live feedback from the virtual environment.
 - Define measurable scoring criteria, evaluation pipelines and automated checks that flag regressions early.
 - Turn problems seen in real operations into reusable test cases so field experience feeds directly back into development.
 - Investigate logs, telemetry and failed runs to pinpoint root causes and help get fixes shipped.
 - Talk with internal teams who rely on the tooling about how hard it is to define and maintain test cases, and build improvements.
 - Embed testing and evaluation tools into the build and release process, including continuous integration and delivery.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - A background building automated verification platforms for machines that combine software with physical hardware.
 - Proven ability to ship production-grade software in C++.
 - Experience creating systems that measure or validate performance quantitatively, including end-to-end data replay pipelines, ideally fed by vehicle sensor data.
 - Working knowledge of concurrency, performance, reliability and Linux, along with awareness of where virtual or replayed behavior diverges from reality.
 - Bachelor's degree.
 - Ability to work on-site in a hybrid arrangement in Alameda, CA.
 Bonus points
 - Exposure to real-world autonomous platforms, whether vehicles, robots or aircraft.
 - Python skills for scripting, data analysis or building test utilities.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 144,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 Location and work model
 - Alameda, CA, United States
 - Hybrid
 - Full-time
